facts.fact: The Botswana Digital & Innovation Hub (BDIH) data centre is operating as a carrier-neutral colocation facility renting quarter, half and full racks and power to tenants, with BoFiNet, VBN and BTC connected (page dated by proxy, 2020-02-27).

note: Page says only that it has the features that make up a tier three data centre; no certification or Tier III rating stated, so no tier3 fact.
